paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance change brought by different sizes of the in-context pool.

model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the variation in minADE₂₀ (a trajectory prediction metric, where lower values indicate better performance) as the size of the in-context pool, represented by the "Ratio" on the x-axis, increases from 0.2 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The x-axis is linear and labeled "Ratio," while the y-axis is also linear and labeled "minADE₂₀ (←)", indicating that lower values are preferred. The plot compares five different methods: TrajICL (blue circles), Head Tuning (orange circles), FT (green circles), LoRA 16 (red circles), and LoRA 64 (purple circles). All lines show a general downward trend or plateau as the Ratio increases, indicating improved performance with larger context sizes. TrajICL starts at approximately 16.7 and decreases steadily to about 15.5 at Ratio = 1.0. Head Tuning begins around 17.4 and plateaus near 17.1. FT starts at 16.1, drops to about 15.9 at Ratio = 0.8, then slightly rises to approximately 16.05 at Ratio = 1.0. LoRA 16 starts at 17.4 and gradually decreases to about 16.9. LoRA 64 begins at 17.3 and declines to roughly 16.8. All trajectories remain relatively close to each other except for TrajICL, which consistently achieves the lowest minADE₂₀ values.
model_annotations.German: This line plot illustrates the change in performance, measured by minADE₂₀ (lower is better), as the size of the in-context pool varies, represented by the "Ratio" on the x-axis. The x-axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with a linear scale, marked at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minADE₂₀ (←)", ranges from approximately 15.5 to 17.5, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. Five different methods are compared: TrajICL (blue circles, solid line), Head Tuning (orange circles, solid line), FT (green circles, solid line), LoRA 16 (red circles, solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple circles, solid line). As the Ratio increases from 0.0 to 1.0, TrajICL shows a consistent decline in minADE₂₀, starting at approximately 16.7 and ending at about 15.5. Head Tuning remains relatively stable, starting at around 17.4 and ending at approximately 17.1. FT starts at about 16.8, decreases slightly to around 16.0 at Ratio 0.6, then increases to approximately 16.1 at Ratio 1.0. LoRA 16 begins at roughly 17.3, gradually decreases to about 17.0 at Ratio 1.0. LoRA 64 starts at approximately 17.3, decreases slightly to around 17.0 at Ratio 0.6, and then continues to decline to about 16.9 at Ratio 1.0. All lines are solid and use circular markers, with no additional line styles or patterns.
